subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose restart catch-up controls in public cron config, and should the supported shape be the existing global max/stagger knobs, a skip/freshness policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the choice changes restart semantics for existing scheduled jobs.

options.title: Expose narrow global controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up settings based on the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

options.title: Design a skip/freshness policy first
options.body: Define a global or per-job missed-run policy that preserves current defaults while letting user-facing jobs opt out of stale replay.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config and document the current fixed restart catch-up behavior and operational workarounds.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow global controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up settings based on the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public config and scheduler-semantics decision, and steipete has adjacent cron startup history plus timeline involvement.
